title: Difficulty-targeted reweighted LightGBM member -- fold-0 falsifier

scope.no_folds_1_4: folds 1-4 are the FIT partition only; they are NOT evaluated as outer folds here
scope.submission_budget_note: 0 of 2 final submissions used; none authorized by this prereg

anti_leakage_audit.primary_non_negotiable: Never leak. No fold-0 label information in any supervised fit (features, weights, targets, early-stopping).
forbidden_training_inputs: Atlas pred_a / pred_b (difficulty predictions for folds 1-4)
Atlas stored route / aux vectors for folds 1-4
any diagnostic whose producing model trained on fold-0 labels

contamination_proof.route: champion route for fold k = TabPFN trained on folds != k; for k in 1..4 this set contains fold 0 -> route[fold k] is a function of fold-0 labels
contamination_proof.aux: classical(k,...) trains each aux member on fi = flatnonzero(folds != k); for k in 1..4 fi contains fold 0 -> aux[fold k] is a function of fold-0 labels
contamination_proof.atlas_target: Atlas per-row shared burden for fold-k rows is computed from route[fold k] and aux[fold k]; therefore the burden/flag for folds 1-4 carries fold-0 label information transitively
contamination_proof.atlas_difficulty_model: Atlas pred_a for fold k is trained on folds != k (contains fold 0 for k>=1) with the contaminated flag as target; doubly contaminated
contamination_proof.conclusion: NONE of per_row_burden.parquet, pred_a, pred_b, stored route/aux for folds 1-4 may be used as training weights for a fold-0 evaluation.

anti_leakage_audit.primary_constraint: difficulty weights for FIT rows (folds 1-4) must be built from predictions that NEVER saw fold 0
anti_leakage_audit.reconstruction_rule: inner cross-fit strictly within FIT (folds 1-4); each FIT row judged/predicted by a model trained only on folds subseteq {1,2,3,4}

documented_deviations.faithful_target: champion SHARED difficulty = misranked pairs where BOTH champion route (TabPFN) AND champion aux (LGBM ens) fail, for FIT rows
documented_deviations.why_blocked: the faithful target requires FOLD-0-SAFE champion route predictions for folds 1-4; the champion route is TabPFN (GPU). Rebuilding it fold-0-safely means 4 TabPFN trainings inside FIT, which is heavy GPU and explicitly out of scope for H19-A (CPU-only, no heavy GPU).
documented_deviations.blocking_status: BLOCKED on budget for the faithful target; a blocking diagnostic is recorded in the run output and report.
documented_deviations.substitute: fold-0-safe CPU PROXY shared difficulty = misranked pairs where TWO fold-0-safe CPU LightGBM judges (inner-cross-fitted within FIT) BOTH fail
documented_deviations.justification: both judges are trained only on folds subseteq {1,2,3,4}; the proxy keeps the 'shared (two independent models both fail)' definition while staying CPU-only and fold-0-safe. The judges are CPU LGBM stand-ins, NOT the TabPFN route -- this substitution is explicit, budget-driven, and reported as a limitation.
documented_deviations.scope_of_validity: a positive result is evidence about the upweight-HARD-ROWS MECHANISM under a fold-0-safe proxy difficulty; it does NOT by itself validate the exact champion-shared-difficulty target (that needs the GPU route reconstruction).

difficulty_reconstruction.inner_crossfit: for inner fold j in {1,2,3,4}: train on FIT\{j}, predict fold j (out-of-sample for fold j, fold-0-safe for all)

judges.purpose: two fold-0-safe satisfaction models whose BOTH-fail pairs define the fold-0-safe shared difficulty
judges.features: rich view 'full' assembled with fi=FIT\{j}, val=fold_j, inner_seed=j (fold-safe TE; never fold 0)
judges.early_stop: inner 10% carved from FIT\{j} only (patience 300); never fold 0

target.definition: within each inner fold j: shared-misranking burden = two_class_counts(y_fold_j, rank(judgeA), rank(judgeB))['burden_neg'] + ['burden_pos']; rate = burden / (n_pos_j + n_neg_j); flag = 1[rate >= per-fold 0.8 quantile]
target.convention: fold-wise top-quintile, matching the Atlas quintile convention
target.fold0_safe: every judge prediction comes from a model trained only on folds subseteq {1,2,3,4}

difficulty_model.features: rich view 'full' covariates ONLY (no labels, no model scores in features)
difficulty_model.inner_crossfit: for inner fold j: train on FIT\{j} (features, flag), predict fold j -> score d_i (out-of-sample for fold j's flag)
difficulty_model.early_stop: inner 10% carved from FIT\{j} only (flag target); never fold 0

difficulty_reconstruction.known_second_order_coupling: flag[FIT\{j}] is produced by judges that saw fold j (not fold 0). This is a weak second-order FIT-label coupling in the difficulty layer. It is fold-0-SAFE (no fold 0 anywhere) and FIT labels influencing FIT weights is allowed; documented, not a fold-0 leak.

weight_function.input: difficulty score d_i for FIT rows (fold-0-safe, inner-cross-fitted)
weight_function.rank: r_i = midrank(d_i) within FIT scaled to [0,1]
weight_function.normalize: w_i = w_raw_i / mean(w_raw over FIT); then clip to [0.25, 2.0]
weight_function.applied_to: the LightGBM TRAINING rows only (trn split of the inner ES); the ES rows are unweighted (AUC early-stop is rank-based)
weight_function.control_weight: all-ones (uniform), same code path as treatment (lgb weight=ones == weight=None exactly)
weight_function.no_post_hoc_search: lambda and bounds are FROZEN here; no weight sweep after seeing fold 0

members.treatment: identical LightGBM, rich view 'full', difficulty weights w on training rows
members.early_stopping: inner 10% split carved from FIT (folds 1-4) ONLY, patience 300; never the eval fold (fold 0)
members.features: ViewBuilder(tr, te, 'full').assemble(fi=FIT, y, val=fold0, inner_seed=member_seed) -- fold-safe TE, fold-0 val TE built from FIT labels only

metrics.primary: fold-0 AUC (exact, sklearn roc_auc_score): control, treatment, delta = treat - ctrl
metrics.mechanism_exact: fold-0 shared-fail pair TOTAL via two_class_counts(y_fold0, rank(route0), rank(aux0)) -- exact integer

mechanism_sampled.what: per-pair treatment/control correctness ON shared-fail pairs and ON non-shared (elsewhere) pairs
mechanism_sampled.method: uniform random cross-class pairs within fold 0 (sample pos index and neg index independently, uniform)
reported: same stats on non-shared pairs (new errors elsewhere)
mechanism_sampled.counts_estimated: sample rate * exact shared-fail total (and * exact non-shared total)
mechanism_sampled.uncertainty: binomial (or multinomial) SE reported for every rate; sampling seed + strategy frozen HERE before results

metrics.correlations: Pearson + Spearman of treatment and control predictions vs champion route0 and aux0 halves

portfolio.composition: equal-weight 11th aux member: aux11 = (10*aux10_logits + member_logits)/11; port = sigmoid((logit(route0) + aux11)/2)
portfolio.rule: equal weight, no tuning on fold 0; key delta = AUC(+treatment) - AUC(+control)
portfolio.exact: composition verified bit-exact against stored champion portfolio for the base variant

decision_rules.s_rate: P(treatment right | shared-fail) - P(control right | shared-fail) from frozen sampling; positive = treatment corrects shared-fail pairs better than control
decision_rules.DEAD: d < +3e-5 AND s_rate <= 0  (no indicative-level standalone improvement AND no shared-fail edge over control); OR d <= 0 AND s_rate <= 0 regardless
decision_rules.PATH_TO_REPLICATION: d >= +3e-5 AND s_sig (s_rate > 0 at >=2 SE) AND portfolio delta (AUC(+treat)-AUC(+ctrl)) >= 0
decision_rules.gates_not_validatable_by_fold0: the full promotion gates (>=1.5e-5 mean paired, >=2.5x paired SE, positive in >=4/5 folds, prefer pooled >=3e-5) CANNOT be validated by fold 0 alone; a PATH verdict only recommends folds 1-4 for FUTURE consideration and does NOT launch them

tests_planned: no fold-0 index in any supervised fit (judges, difficulty model, members)
difficulty provenance: judges/difficulty inner-cross-fitted within FIT only
id alignment: control/treatment predictions aligned to fold-0 ids, no reorder
weight validity: finite, positive, within bounds, reproducible, mean ~1
reproducibility: same seed -> same weights and predictions
champion identity: stored champion portfolio/route hashes + composition bit-exact
arithmetic consistency: stretch target 0.962100000 - 0.9618529228157235 == 0.0002470771842765 (2.47e-4), docs corrected
feature non-regression vs certified rich view

budget.gpu_note: H19-A is CPU-only; the faithful TabPFN route reconstruction is BLOCKED (heavy GPU)
